environment.max_num_seqs_reason: unmodified 1024 default failed boot with hybrid Mamba cache; 512 is a feasibility override, not a benchmark-selected optimization

fixed_chat_diagnostic.client_concurrency_cap: 256 through 3.2 requests/s; 512 for 4.8 and 6.4; raw starts and lag confirm the caps did not bind
fixed_chat_diagnostic.cache_protocol: one server start, disjoint three-request warmup, unique-seed content per cell, no cache reset; common chat template may remain cached

calibration.basis: two 192-request 60-second sending windows sustained approximately 32 starts and completions per 10 seconds after fill; 4.8 retained rising outstanding work; 6.4 clearly accumulated backlog
calibration.ladder_status: 2.56 and 3.2 have frozen payload/schedule assets and one matched B0 replay each; 1.92 and 3.84 cells not yet materialized or validated
calibration.tail_status: provisional; 60-second windows and at most 384 requests per point do not establish stable p99 SLA or long-run capacity

mixed_diagnostic.status: 30-request realization check only; sustainable mixed rate not calibrated

search_gate: Fixed-chat 2.56 and 3.2 payloads and absolute schedules are frozen and live-replayed on B0. Before qualified candidate comparison, repeat matched B0 windows, verify hybrid cache preparation, and separately calibrate mixed/session cards and representative traffic. External request rate is workload input, not a serving parameter proposed by Codex.
